svg.aria-label: dsh-draw structure: image_generate and draw/regenerate merge into one drawer; normalize/validate, then the generation quota gate, then the engine chain as a scoreboard with cooldown health, then the byte quota gate before the attachment store; the commit forks into durable attachment refs and a gated draw/generated session event, and the returns feed the model value, the result card and the Settings tab, with regenerate re-entering the same drawer on the dashed return rail
svg.title: dsh-draw: two mouths, one drawer, two quota gates and a health-aware engine chain
